instruction: Choose a suitable tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD to complete the task. Use a command-line or scripting workflow. Use the selected tool to build and solve a 2D axisymmetric finite-element model of an internally pressurized thick-walled cylinder. Adopt the N-mm-MPa unit system throughout. Geometry: Create a 2D axisymmetric deformable solid part representing the cylinder cross-section. The radial extent is from r = 50 mm to r = 100 mm. The axial extent is from z = 0 mm to z = 10 mm. Material: Define a material named Steel. Set Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Assign this material to the entire cylinder section using a homogeneous solid section. Mesh and Element Type: Employ appropriate axisymmetric solid elements. Use a structured mesh with a global seed size of 5.0 mm. Create the following node sets: ALLNODES (all nodes), INNER (r = 50 mm boundary), OUTER (r = 100 mm boundary), ZMIN (z = 0 mm boundary), and ZMAX (z = 10 mm boundary). Boundary Conditions: On ALLNODES, constrain axial displacement U2 = 0 to enforce the plane-strain condition. Do not apply any additional radial U1 constraint. Loading: Apply internal pressure p = 10 N/mm^2 on the INNER boundary (r = 50 mm), represented as equivalent axisymmetric concentrated nodal forces. For each INNER node at axial position z_i, compute the force in the positive U1 direction as: F_i = p x 2pi x r_in x Delta z_i where r_in = 50 mm. For the first and last INNER nodes, use half the adjacent axial interval for Delta z_i. For interior INNER nodes, use half the distance between neighboring INNER nodes for Delta z_i. Analysis: Create a static analysis step named Step-Pressure. Request field output for U, RF, and S. Create and submit a job named Job-Cylinder, and wait for successful completion. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and native solver result artifact on the Desktop, and write `C:/Users/user/Desktop/metrics.json` with numeric fields for the requested metrics. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
